references.text: God promises Jacob to be with him and protect him, which Jacob claims in 31:42 was fulfilled through God's intervention against Laban.
God reveals Himself to Isaac and confirms the promises made to Abraham. Jacob refers to 'the God of Abraham' and 'the Fear of Isaac' in 31:42.
God warns Laban in a dream not to harm Jacob—this is the specific event 'last night' (אמש) that Jacob refers to in verse 42.
God tells Jacob that He has seen everything Laban has done to him, which directly corresponds with Jacob's words that God saw his suffering and the work of his hands.
The expression 'the Fear of Isaac' (פחד יצחק) is used again here, confirming that this is a title for God that was central to Jacob's faith.
Laban himself admits that Jacob's God spoke to him and warned him, which confirms Jacob's statement in verse 42 that God judged between them.
